raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] "Summons a gang of invisible Archers " Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 2.1 Offensive Strategy 2.2 Defensive Strategy 3 Statistics 3.1 Equipment Migration 4 History 5 Trivia Summary The Archer Puppet is a piece of Hero Equipment for the Archer Queen . It is one of the two Hero Equipment that is unlocked alongside her, the other being the Invisibility Vial . The Archer Puppet enables the Archer Queen to summon a number of Archers when using her ability. These Archers are granted temporary invisibility, but the Queen is not made invisible at the same time, unless she is using other equipment that grants her invisibility. The Archers spawned by the ability are equal in Level to the Level of Archers that the player has researched in the Laboratory . For example, if the player has upgraded Archers to Level 5 in the Laboratory, the ability will spawn Level 5 Archers. In addition to the ability, the Archer Puppet grants additional damage per second to the Archer Queen, and increases the amount of health she recovers when using the ability. Strategies Offensive Strategy The Archer Puppet's Archers can give the Archer Queen additional damage, and distract defenses once they turn visible. However, because the Archer Puppet does not grant invisibility to the Archer Queen herself, defenses will continue to fire upon the Queen, and may also harm invisible Archers through splash damage, unless the Archer Queen is herself using equipment that grants her this, namely the Invisibility Vial or the Magic Mirror . Without an invisibility-granting equipment, the Archer Queen remains vulnerable until the Archers become visible, but spells such as Freeze Spells and Invisibility Spells can buy time for this to happen. At all Levels, the invisibility time of the Archers are shorter than what the Queen has from the Invisibility Vial, allowing them to be targeted first to tank for the Queen. The Archers can assist the Queen in doing additional damage as long as they do not get hit or fall victim to a ground trap. They can also be used to counter the Multi-Archer Tower as the tower will spread its fire to three targets as long as the Archers stay alive, but this requires the Archers to first turn visible. As with usage of the Barbarian Puppet , one should take caution in using the ability near empty spaces in the base, as the summoned Archers can be instantly wiped out by a Bomb or Giant Bomb . To maximize the effectiveness of the ability, it is recommended that Archers are upgraded as much as possible in the Laboratory, even if they are not used elsewhere in the army, as the Level of Archers spawned correspond to the Level of Archers you have in your Laboratory. Defensive Strategy Despite the invisibility, splash defenses and traps can still damage the Archers if they are in the splash radius, mainly cause by the Archer Queen being the target. A voodoo doll is an effigy that is typically used for the insertion of pins. Such practices are found in various forms in the magical traditions of many cultures around the world. The Archer Puppet is one of the first equipment to be added to the game, alongside the Barbarian Puppet , Rage Vial , Earthquake Boots , Vampstache , Invisibility Vial , Giant Arrow , Healer Puppet , Eternal Tome , Life Gem , Rage Gem , Healing Tome , Royal Gem , and Seeking Shield . The Archer Puppet is one of the equipment that spawn additional troops when activated, the others being Barbarian Puppet, Healer Puppet, Action Figure , Hechnmen Puppet , Lavaloon Puppet , and Hog Rider Puppet . The Archer Puppet is one of the Common equipment that do not require the Blacksmith to be built in order to unlock them, the others being Barbarian Puppet, Rage Vial, and Invisibility Vial. If the player does not have Archers unlocked, the Archer Puppet will spawn a minimum of Level 1 Archers. Despite requiring a Level 7 Blacksmith in order to have a Level 15 Archer Puppet, it can be obtained from as low as a Level 1 Blacksmith. This can happen due to the Equipment Migration in the Town Hall 16 Update (see Statistics above).
